title: Apple Updates Entry-Level MacBook Pro With M6 Chip
excerpt: Apple has refreshed its entry-level MacBook Pro with the new M6 processor, following previous upgrades to the Mac Mini.
body_html:
Apple has announced a hardware refresh for its entry-level MacBook Pro, equipping the laptop with the new M6 chip. This follows last year's upgrade that introduced the M5 processor to the same model.

The company initially launched the M6 chip in August as part of updates to the Mac Mini. The latest revision brings this processor to the entry-level portable computer lineup.
